caption: the licensed oddity that works - shego playable, monkey fist shenanigans, actual co-op.
about: Kim possible: what's the switch? (2005) is the rare licensed platformer that respects its license: kim and a playable shego chase drakken's monkey-master plan across levels that mix combat, gadgets and actual co-op challenges. The show's comedic timing survives the translation, which is more than most disney-adjacent games of the era managed.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
